key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh tasks from Google Tasks.

key.name: task-sort-order
key.description: How tasks are sorted in the panel.

key.name: show-task-date
key.description: Whether to show, next to each task title, when the task was created — or, in the completed section, when it was completed.

key.name: show-completed-tasks
key.description: Whether to show completed tasks in a collapsible section.

key.name: task-timeframe
key.description: Which due date range to display in the panel.

key.name: language
key.description: Language used for the extension's own UI text (labels, buttons, placeholder messages). Does not affect task content itself.

key.name: column-width
key.description: Width in pixels of the Google Tasks column in the calendar popup.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner rounding in pixels for colored task rows and their edit form.

key.name: completed-retention-minutes
key.description: Automatically delete completed tasks this many minutes after completion. 0 disables auto-deletion.

key.name: title-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for task and subtask titles.

key.name: description-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for task and subtask descriptions.

key.name: task-block-size
key.description: Vertical padding in pixels for top-level task rows.

key.name: subtask-block-size
key.description: Vertical padding in pixels for subtask rows.

key.name: radio-size
key.description: Width and height in pixels of the completion circle for tasks.

key.name: subtask-radio-size
key.description: Width and height in pixels of the completion circle for subtasks.

key.name: subtask-levels
key.description: How many levels tasks can nest: 2 is task and subtask, 3 also allows a subtask of a subtask.

key.name: subtask-levels-request
key.description: Written by the preferences when the nesting limit is lowered: JSON with a request id and the new limit. The extension checks every task list and only then changes subtask-levels.

key.name: subtask-levels-result
key.description: Written by the extension in answer to subtask-levels-request: JSON saying whether the new limit was applied, and if not, which tasks are nested too deep.

key.name: empty-state-icon
key.description: Symbolic icon name shown above the "no tasks" placeholder message.

key.name: empty-state-icon-size
key.description: Size in pixels of the icon shown above the "no tasks" placeholder message.

key.name: empty-state-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels of the "no tasks" placeholder message.

key.name: empty-state-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage applied to both the icon and text of the "no tasks" placeholder.

key.name: task-blocks-enabled
key.description: Whether "my tasks" and "completed" are drawn as separate shaded blocks.

key.name: task-blocks-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the task blocks as a percentage of the shell theme's notification bubble opacity: 100 matches a notification exactly, lower is more transparent, higher more solid.

key.name: task-blocks-edge-blur
key.description: Width in pixels of the soft edge on the task blocks and the task-list picker. 0 draws a crisp 1px outline instead.
